title: Google\Cloud\DataCatalog\V1\BigQueryDateShardedSpec
name: BigQueryDateShardedSpec
description: Spec for a group of BigQuery tables with name pattern [prefix]YYYYMMDD.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.dataset
params.description: Output only. The Data Catalog resource name of the dataset entry the current table belongs to, for example, projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/entrygroups/{entry_group_id}/entries/{entry_id}.

params.name: data.table_prefix
params.description: Output only. The table name prefix of the shards. The name of any given shard is [table_prefix]YYYYMMDD, for example, for shard MyTable20180101, the table_prefix is MyTable.
